text: DSH Team Fishbone（DSH 网页客户端插件）：在会话标题栏提供团队鱼骨图面板，读取会话中的子 Agent 目录、状态及可用的团队任务投影，展示主 Agent 与子 Agent 的层级关系、分工、运行状态和任务进度。点击节点可查看任务说明、执行时长、Token 与步骤等可用指标、最近过程摘要，并可在原生界面打开子会话查看执行过程。面板支持中英文、嵌套子 Agent 导航和缺失数据提示，适合需要在 DSH 中了解团队执行情况并切换子会话的用户；使用需宿主提供相应会话与界面接口。

DSH Team Fishbone (DSH web plugin) adds a fishbone panel to the conversation header. It displays sub-agent hierarchy, assignments, status, and task progress. Select a node for available metrics and trace details, then open its child session. The interface supports Chinese and English.

**DSH Team Fishbone** 的功能「团队鱼骨图」：在会话标题栏打开交互面板，以鱼骨节点展示主 Agent、子 Agent 及可用的嵌套层级；点击节点可进入详情。。从会话标题栏的团队鱼骨按钮打开并选择节点。
**DSH Team Fishbone** 的功能「子 Agent 状态与指标」：汇总运行、完成、结束或空闲状态，并显示可用的用时、Token 与步数；缺失数据以占位符显示。可在标题栏打开面板并选择节点查看。
**DSH Team Fishbone** 的功能「分工和共享任务进度」：根据目录标签与团队成员描述显示子 Agent 职责，并将共享任务按负责人关联，呈现完成数量和任务条目。。从会话标题栏的团队鱼骨按钮打开并选择节点。
**DSH Team Fishbone** 的功能「查看过程并打开子会话」：在详情中展示投影提供的最近输入和输出摘要；点击打开按钮可跳转到对应原生子会话。。从会话标题栏的团队鱼骨按钮打开并选择节点。

A session-header panel for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): visualize sub-agents as an interactive fishbone diagram, inspect assignments and live state, then open the child session for its full execution trace.

DSH 会话标题栏的团队看板：用鱼骨图展示主 Agent 与子 Agent 的分配关系、任务描述、运行状态和可用的用时/Token 指标，点击节点查看详情并进入子会话。

text:
@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Features / 功能：- Direct sub-agent fishbone nodes plus nested child navigation when their catalog projections are loaded.
- 运行中使用主题品牌色与动态连接线；已完成使用成功色；已结束使用警告色；空闲和失败分别使用中性及错误色。
- Assignments come from sub-agent catalog labels and teammate descriptions; shared task-board entries are optional, not required for nodes to appear.
- 子节点详情含快捷切换、任务说明、可用的轮次/步骤/Token/用时指标；过程摘要仅在宿主下发对应投影时展示。
- One click opens the native sub-agent session; the plugin does not create agents or change shared tasks.
- 中英双语，跟随宿主主题，无第三方运行时依赖，无安装脚本。

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Install / 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-team-fishbone/releases/latest/download/dsh-team-fishbone.tgz
```

Desktop users should install through their running app's plugin manager, not an unrelated `web` profile. Follow the installation result for refresh/restart instructions.

桌面版请通过正在使用的应用安装到当前 profile；不要另建 `web` profile。安装后按宿主提示刷新或重启，再点击会话标题旁的「团队鱼骨」。

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Local development / 本地开发：```sh
git clone https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-team-fishbone.git
cd dsh-team-fishbone
npm test
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts

Install the absolute directory through `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`. There is no build step: the checked-in client file is the browser artifact.

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Compatibility / 兼容说明：Developed and manually tried on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. Uses the native conversation header slot, sub-agent catalog, session-status hooks, and optional experimental Agent Teams projections. Older versions are not verified; experimental projection contracts may change. Missing summary data is displayed as unavailable rather than invented.

已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 环境中开发并人工试用。依赖原生会话标题栏 slot、子代理目录及状态 hooks；Agent Teams 共享任务板是可选数据源。其他版本尚未完成兼容测试。

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Privacy / 数据：The plugin reads projections already available to the local DSH client and requests native child-session projection refreshes. It adds no external network endpoint, analytics, or credential storage. It does not bundle session transcripts, personal paths, or tokens.

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Releases / 持续发布：See [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md). Tags matching the package version trigger GitHub Actions to check the bundle and attach a fixed-name `dsh-team-fishbone.tgz` plus SHA-256 checksums to a GitHub Release. The package is distributed through GitHub; it is **not published to npm**.

The `@local/dsh-team-fishbone` name is retained to preserve existing installations. It is a package identifier, not a claim of npm availability.

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Community market / 市场收录：The market application reads the [Awesome DSH Plugin catalog](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin). Listing requires a separate catalog PR and maintainer acceptance; a public repository alone does not make the plugin searchable there. See [marketplace/outmanwt__dsh-team-fishbone.yml](marketplace/outmanwt__dsh-team-fishbone.yml) for the proposed entry.

@local/dsh-team-fishbone README · Credits / 致谢：Uses the DSH/Cordis extension APIs. Some projection-reading and native-session-navigation patterns were adapted from the MIT-licensed DeepSeek Harness built-in Agent Teams and sub-agent UI packages. See [NOTICE](NOTICE).
